entities.summary: Mitsuyo Kakuta is a Japanese author born in Yokohama. She has been engaged in translating into modern Japanese the 11th-century proto-novel The Tale of Genji by Murasaki Shikibu (紫式部). Mitsuyo Kakuta was a authors & novelists from Yokohama (b. 1967-03-08, Yokohama). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
